name: pages
meaning: the choice node array whose root the attached list walks (PorkyLevel01_PostLoadInit 0x45ab26-0x45ab32 stores &choicePages here, &choiceMenu at +8)

name: list
meaning: attached choice list; its s16 at +4 is the row count and its u16 at +8 the cursor row

name: cursorRow
meaning: highlighted choice row, derived from list[+8]-1

name: fits
meaning: 1 when body plus list fits the window

name: bgColor
meaning: panel fill colour passed to Ui_DrawPanelFill
